From 10:00 AM onward, both trains are moving toward each other: the first train at 60 mph and the second train at 80 mph. Their combined speed is 60 + 80 = 140 mph. To cover the remaining 240 miles at this combined speed, the time taken is:

$$
\frac{240 \text{ miles}}{140 \text{ mph}} = \frac{12}{7} \text{ hours} \approx 1.714 \text{ hours} = 1 \text{ hour and } 43 \text{ minutes}.
$$
